source_row.rationale: Serious burns disrupt skin integrity and infection prevention is important, but the prior item overstated a universal 'stricter isolation' approach. CDC's scientific review states that there is no consensus on the most effective special infection-control configuration for serious burn patients and no defined universal combination of barrier precautions. Standard Precautions and indicated Transmission-Based Precautions remain fundamental, with additional burn-unit practices based on risk and facility policy.
source_row.source_detail: Scientific review section on patients with serious burns: no consensus on the most effective special infection-control practices or barrier-precaution combination; evidence supports emphasis on hand hygiene and appropriate barriers for direct contact.
source_row.source_name: CDC — Isolation Precautions Scientific Review: Burn Patients
source_row.stem: A nurse on a burn unit asks whether every patient with a serious burn automatically requires a special universal 'burn isolation' protocol beyond Standard and indicated Transmission-Based Precautions. Which response is most accurate?
